method.summary: Thin-slab 2D-to-volume rigid alignment followed by multiple SimpleITK B-spline fits; compared warped anatomical patches, neighborhood-correlation refinements and orthogonal MIP views. Added custom local3D translation around the warped patch surfaces. Chose denser corr7 for most points with point-specific local radius choices, and gradient-based edge7 for q03.

rigid_stage.fixed_image: Source2D view repeated5 times, 1.5mm slab spacing, nominal world frame.

bspline_stage.fixed_image: HU clipped[-1000,300], repeated5-slice slab at1mm; mask sourceHU<-100.
bspline_stage.composition: Output world point = rigid(bspline(nominal_source_world)); SetMovingInitialTransform(rigid) during fitting.

neighborhood_correlation_stage.optimizer: LBFGSB, all pixels, shrink2/1; reduced gradient tolerance after zero-iteration first pass.
neighborhood_correlation_stage.role: Exploratory res_cc5 warped-patch baseline; not the final base used by seven selected points.

local_translation_stage.coordinates: Orthonormal tangent/normal frame estimated by finite differences of the warped surface at each query.
local_translation_stage.objective: NCC of clipped[-1000,300] source patch and sampled inhale values across the warped surface plus constant3D shift.
local_translation_stage.optimizer: SciPy differential_evolution, seed=radius, tol=.05, polish=True; final stage popsize6,maxiter25.
local_translation_stage.stability_checks: Compared radii, base-vs-refined NCC, warped patch panels, HU at points, and orthogonal MIP images. Some DE results have worse NCC than zero shift; alternatives remained visible to the model.

edge_stage.objective: SimpleITK correlation of smoothed gradient magnitudes, sampled70% seed12; LBFGSB70 iterations
edge_stage.role: Selected for q03 only; other points use localopt7 outputs.

final_selection.selection_author: Sol model only, after its own quantitative and visual checks; no supervising selection/hints.
final_selection.final_validation: Eight query IDs/order, finite8x3 coordinates, and within-volume voxel bounds. No hidden geometric feedback.
final_selection.limitation: Different radii/stages were selected per landmark. Visible commentary describes the two ambiguous landmarks as resolved, but does not expose a complete deterministic selection rule; encrypted reasoning is unavailable.
